sources.title: HSE — Controls to prevent violence
sources.date_or_extent: Current page; no date relied on
sources.claim: Calm communication, personal space, risk-specific training and established emergency procedures.
sources.limit: Workplace guidance; no universal successful script or required eye-contact norm.

sources.title: HSE — Advice for workers
sources.date_or_extent: Current page; no date relied on
sources.claim: Use employer training, report incidents and seek support.
sources.limit: Great Britain workplace context; not an abuse safety plan or worldwide legal-duty statement.

sources.title: GOV.UK — Reasonable force against intruders
sources.date_or_extent: Current page; no update date relied on
sources.claim: Limited home-intruder example: circumstances matter; continuing an attack after danger ends can lead to prosecution.
sources.limit: Do not export home-specific guidance to all settings or jurisdictions; no individual legal verdict.

sources.title: NPS — Ten Essentials
sources.claim: Trip-specific equipment categories; shelter, clothing, navigation, water, food and local fire rules.
sources.limit: Inventory is not observed equipment skill; source does not validate this exercise or authorize fire use.

sources.title: NPS — Trip Planning Guide
sources.date_or_extent: Current page; no date relied on
sources.claim: Conditions, activity/skill fit, backup plan, trusted contact and changed-condition decisions.
sources.limit: Park day/overnight guidance; not a remote expedition qualification or universal turnaround time.

sources.title: American Red Cross — Water Safety
sources.date_or_extent: Current page; no date relied on
sources.claim: Water-competence components, environment hazards, layers of protection and safe helping awareness.
sources.limit: Benchmarks are not unsupervised instructions; no guide-derived rescue qualification or pool-to-river equivalence.

sources.title: RNLI — Cold water shock
sources.date_or_extent: Current page; no date relied on
sources.claim: Cold water can affect breathing and movement; flotation and relevant preparation matter.
sources.limit: No cold-immersion test or guaranteed survival claim; no numeric temperature rule used to declare water safe.

sources.title: U.S. State Department — International Travel Checklist
sources.claim: Destination rules, travel documents, medicine legality, personal needs and insurance coverage checks.
sources.limit: U.S. traveler context; actual nationality/transit/date requirements need their own current sources.

sources.title: FTC — Recover a hacked account
sources.claim: Provider recovery; password/session/recovery/forwarding checks; unauthorized messages and contact warning.
sources.limit: Provider-specific action required; successful sign-in is not universal incident closure.

sources.title: FTC — What to do if scammed
sources.date_or_extent: Current page inspected; current index identifies 2026-06-30 update
sources.claim: Prompt institution contact through independent route, payment-specific recovery requests and exposed-information response.
sources.limit: U.S. examples; no guaranteed refund, invented entitlement or universal deadline.

sources.title: FTC — Identity theft
sources.date_or_extent: Current page; no date relied on
sources.claim: Personal-information misuse, monitoring limits, protected information and U.S. identity recovery route.
sources.limit: Exposure differs from established later misuse; credit measures are jurisdiction-specific, not performed here.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-34 Rev. 1 — Contingency Planning
sources.claim: Contingency requirements and priorities for information systems and operations.
sources.limit: Only landing abstract used. Club plan, time arithmetic and four-stage teaching are an author-created analogy, not compliance certification.

sources.title: FEMA IS-244.B — Developing and Managing Volunteers
sources.date_or_extent: Current course text inspected; publication date not inferred
sources.claim: Defined volunteer roles, training, matching capability, supervision, coordination and limits.
sources.limit: U.S. emergency-management course; no authority conferred on unaffiliated learners or medical/transport roles.

sources.title: CDC — Preventing Respiratory Illnesses
sources.claim: Core prevention categories and context-dependent additional precautions; individual immunization discussion.
sources.limit: Not a club-specific outbreak notice, clinical regimen or fixed isolation schedule.

sources.title: CDC — Cleaner Air
sources.claim: General outdoor-air, cleaning-air and setting options; separate healthcare context.
sources.limit: No HVAC design claim, measured room safety or automatic window-opening rule.

sources.title: Right To Be — Five Ds of Bystander Intervention
sources.date_or_extent: Current guide; no date relied on
sources.claim: Five strategies, direct-intervention risk and responsible documentation/permission.
sources.limit: Guide is first-party training guidance, not proof this exercise prevents violence; emergency/safeguarding duties require context.

sources.title: NIOSH — Hierarchy of Controls
sources.claim: Elimination, substitution, engineering, administrative measures and PPE; new risks from substitutions.
sources.limit: No specialist PPE selection, whole-site inspection or learner authority to remove arbitrary hazards.

sources.title: HSE — Maintenance of work equipment
sources.date_or_extent: Current page inspected; dated search metadata not used as legal currency
sources.claim: Competent maintenance, isolation, accidental restart and stored-energy hazards.
sources.limit: No procedural lockout instruction; actual site/equipment process requires trained authorized people.

sources.title: Weger et al. — Relative Effectiveness of Active Listening
sources.claim: 115 participants; active listening improved feeling understood relative to advice/acknowledgment; satisfaction did not distinguish it from advice.
sources.limit: Abstract evidence only; no therapeutic efficacy, universal relationship effect or validation of these prompts.

sources.title: EPA — Wildfires and Indoor Air Quality
sources.date_or_extent: Current page; no date relied on
sources.claim: Outdoor smoke can enter buildings; local alerts and hazard-specific indoor-air decisions matter.
sources.limit: Home-focused guidance motivates reassessment, not a ventilation prescription for the fictional club.

sources.title: NCSC — Managing your passwords
sources.date_or_extent: Body reviewed/updated 2026-05-21; older metadata also visible
sources.claim: Unique credentials, second factors, protected device access, updates and supported passkeys.
sources.limit: No product recommendation, universal recovery workflow or promise that any account is invulnerable.
